quote: The evaluation cutoff K can be a fixed number (e.g., F1@5 compares the top-5 keyphrases predicted by the model with the ground-truth to compute an F1 score). Following the previous work , we adopt macro-averaged recall and F-measure (F1) as evaluation metrics
